_comment: Per-station sync manifest for the Mac Mini (fleet production node). Station is resolved via `scutil --get LocalHostName`; a machine with NO manifest file gets the default full sync (laptops: damilola-mba, damilola-mbp). settings 'merge' mode: repo wins ONLY on settings_owned_keys — every other live key survives untouched, so fleet-local settings can never be clobbered by a sync. To hand a drifted key to repo control, add it to settings_owned_keys deliberately (that is the ratification step). hooks_owned_events does the same thing one level down, for settings.hooks: repo wins only on the listed event names, so an event left off (Notification, PermissionRequest — D removed the afplay sound hooks on this headless node 2026-09-17) keeps whatever is live and is never read or written by sync.
